e2bBehaviour.summary: A closed disclosure on the saved mission page, shown only when the books switch is on. No checkbox: the cannot-recall notice is shown above the buttons inside the panel, with the same sentence in the PDF. Two buttons, 'Download Trip Book (PDF)' and 'Download Supplier Book (PDF)'.
e2bBehaviour.retries: The same commandId is reused on retry. CURRENT RULE (89776fc): it is forgotten ONLY on success, a 409, a 422 with reason UNSUPPORTED_TEXT or EMPTY, and the 401/403 full clear. A 429, 503, 404, any other 4xx or 5xx, a timeout, a non-PDF response and a missing digest or time header KEEP it. A 60 s client timeout shows 'could not confirm'. The object URL is revoked after 10 s. SUPERSEDED (eae5140 and f7caeb3, and the first version of this record at 1033c4a): the id was also forgotten on a 429.
e2bBehaviour.codexP2On1033c4a: Codex P2 on PR 258 (head 1033c4a): the route calls s.delivery.budget(...) BEFORE s.customerBooks.generate(...), and that budget also covers replays and reads, so a 429 can arrive for a retry whose earlier attempt DID commit a record (the answer was lost). Forgetting the id on 429 would make the next retry create a second ledger record and a second event. The SQL-cap 429 (SQLSTATE 54000, the 31st new generation in an hour) is raised inside the generation transaction before the ledger insert, so no record exists for it; keeping the id there is harmless (the retry generates once the cap clears). Fixed in 89776fc. Copy unchanged (books.tooMany = 'Too many downloads for this mission just now. Try again later.'). Tests: the operator refusals table now asserts that a 429 keeps the SAME id; a new test has the first POST commit with the answer lost (network error), the retry get 429, the next retry get 200: 3 POSTs, ONE distinct commandId, exactly 1 record in the mock ledger; a press after that success makes a new command and a second record. The operator spec now has 36 tests.
e2bBehaviour.accessibility: An empty kind uses aria-disabled with a visible reason and keeps focus. A denial shows one dedicated alert and moves focus to it; a 401 adds a Sign in again link.
